description: SplashBI launches Hyderabad GCC and invests US$4 million in an AI data centre to boost enterprise AI, data intelligence and analytics globally today.
body_lead: | Sri D. Sridhar Babu, Hon’ble Minister for IT, Electronics & Communications, Industries & Commerce, Government of Telangana, mark the inauguration of the SplashBI's Global Capability Centre at VSD Tech Park, Hyderabad | - New centre to strengthen the company’s platform engineering and AI capabilities to help enterprises progress from fragmented data to informed decisions - Earmarks US$4 million for an AI data centre as investment to strengthen AI infrastructure and capabilities. - Centre at VSD Tech Park, Financial District, inaugurated by Sri D.
